lines.en: label wakanaspring5:
I can’t show you what I look like. I can’t mimic how she speaks.
lines.zh: 我没法让你看见我的模样。我没法模仿她说话的样子。

lines.en: But I’ll hold your hand and weep with you when tragedy repeats.
lines.zh: 但我会握着你的手，在悲剧重演时陪你一起哭。

lines.en: Because time is sure to take me next — and when it does, don’t fret.
lines.zh: 因为时间下一个要带走的必定是我——到那时，别慌。

lines.en: Just leave my ashes on display somewhere you won’t forget.
lines.zh: 只要把我的骨灰摆在一个你忘不掉的地方就好。

lines.en: scene 3
scene 2
scene 1
scene wakanathefriend1
I AM VERY SAD
lines.zh: 我非常难过

lines.en: But I’m sure you probably get that already since I’ve always been sad and have gone through various phases in which that sadness is heavier than normal. Like when I raped Molly or killed Maya.
lines.zh: 不过我想你大概早就知道了——毕竟我一直都很难过，而且经历过好几个「比平常更难过」的阶段。比如我强暴 Molly 的时候，或者我杀死 Maya 的时候。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend2
THIS IS ANOTHER ONE OF THOSE TIMES
lines.zh: 这又是其中一个阶段

lines.en: Just this time probably won’t last as long because I’ve got battle-hardened skin now and could stop a truck with my cock-flesh if it approached me at top speed during sex.
lines.zh: 只不过这次大概不会持续那么久，因为我现在皮糙肉厚——做爱的时候就算有辆卡车全速朝我冲过来，我也能用我那根玩意儿的肉把它拦下来。

lines.en: TODAY, I TAKE THE TRASH OUT
lines.zh: 今天，我把垃圾扔了

lines.en: It’s why I got out of bed. They call it “responsibility” in other parts of the world (the ones I will never see) ///Weebnote/Godnote: “World” in this context is in relation to the world not the World.
lines.zh: 这是我起床的理由。在世界别的地方，人们管这叫「责任感」（那些地方我永远看不到）///Weebnote/Godnote：这里的「世界」指的是这个世界，不是那个「世界」。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend3
it looked something like this (get it haha wrong image still relevant so DEEP)
lines.zh: 大概就是这么个样子（懂了吧哈哈，图是错的但依然贴切，好深刻）

lines.en: The takeout menus are still on the table from when Niki left for the beach and one of Ami’s socks is in the dryer. I can’t bring myself to move either.
lines.zh: Niki 去海边之后留下的外卖菜单还在桌上，Ami 的一只袜子还在烘干机里。这两样我都提不起劲去动。

lines.en: THERE IS NOTHING ON TV
lines.zh: 电视上什么都没有

lines.en: scene lr_day
Okay, I’m good now.
lines.zh: 好了，我没事了。

lines.en: Just needed to get that out of the way really quickly before I make a phone call to redeem a friendship coupon.
lines.zh: 只是想在打那通电话、兑现一张「友情券」之前，赶紧把这些倒出来。

lines.en: The bright side of everyone leaving me is that I can pretty much bring anyone I want over here now without risking getting in trouble. Maybe.
lines.zh: 所有人都离开我，好处是我现在基本可以把任何想带的人带回家，不怕惹麻烦。大概吧。

lines.en: Technically, Niki could come back at any moment and pretend she still loves me as more than just a stray dog she made the mistake of taking in.
lines.zh: 严格说来，Niki 随时可能回来，然后装作她对我的爱不止是「对一只她一时糊涂捡回来的流浪狗」的那种。

lines.en: Just she hasn’t yet. She’s been gone for a while. And I’d be really worried about her fucking some other guy if she knew any and all of them weren’t up in space dying from asphyxiation or whatever.
lines.zh: 只是她还没回来。她已经走了有一阵子了。要不是我知道所有男人都在太空中窒息而死之类的，我真会担心她在跟别的男人上床。

lines.en: Anyway, phone time.
lines.zh: 总之，该打电话了。

lines.en: I tap on Wakana’s name in my phone and-
lines.zh: 我在手机里点开 Wakana 的名字，然后——

lines.en: : Hello?
Oh thank god.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地。

lines.en: : Hey. So remember that time you were really miserable and needed me to come over so you could cry into my shoulder and make me buy you dinner?
lines.zh: : 嘿。还记得你那次特别惨、需要我过去让你趴在我肩上哭、还让我请你吃饭吗？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, but I think you have the wrong number. Please don’t call here again. Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我想你打错电话了。以后别再打来。再见。

lines.en: : Wakana, I could really use your company.
lines.zh: : Wakana，我真的需要你陪。

lines.en: : I’ve been standing in the middle of my living room staring at the floor for I think thirty minutes now. And I imagine that is what I will do for the rest of the day if you don’t come snap me out of it.
lines.zh: : 我已经在客厅中央站着盯地板盯了大概三十分钟。你要不来把我叫醒，我估计一整天都会这么站着。

lines.en: : Oh good. We can be miserable together then. I’ll shower and head over in twenty minutes.
lines.zh: : 哦好。那我们可以一起惨了。我洗个澡，二十分钟后过去。

lines.en: : Great. But I get to be the more miserable one today since you had your turn already.
lines.zh: : 好啊。不过今天我得是更惨的那个，因为你已经轮过一次了。

lines.en: : Okay. But that doesn’t mean I won’t be silently competing with you in my own head.
lines.zh: : 行。不过这不代表我不会在心里默默跟你比。

lines.en: : I also expect a hug.
lines.zh: : 我还要一个拥抱。

lines.en: : Jesus, Arakawa. Are you fucking dying?
lines.zh: : 天呐，荒川。你他妈是要死了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : No. I just miss you and you smell nice and no one touches me in this house anymore.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是想你了，而且你闻起来很好闻，这屋子里已经没人碰我了。

lines.en: : Perhaps I’ll bring a ball-gag as well if it’ll get you to stop this infantile whimpering.
lines.zh: : 也许我该顺带带个口塞来，好让你别再这么幼稚地哼唧。

lines.en: : Can I make you wear it instead?
lines.zh: : 我可以让你戴吗？

lines.en: : Will that make you feel better?
lines.zh: : 那样你会好受点？

lines.en: : Probably, yeah.
lines.zh: : 大概会吧。

lines.en: : Then no. See you in half an hour.
lines.zh: : 那就不行。半小时后见。

lines.en: scene black
Wakana hangs up the phone and I know that these thirty minutes will pass by in no time at all since I’ve already been standing here for that long.
lines.zh: Wakana 挂了电话，而我知道这三十分钟会一晃就过——毕竟我已经在这儿站了那么久了。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend4
See? She’s already here and I didn’t even have to let her inside. Not locking the door worked out in my favor for once.
lines.zh: 瞧？她已经到了，我连门都不用去开。没锁门这回倒是帮了我一次。

lines.en: : Wow, Arakawa. You look terrible.
lines.zh: : 哇，荒川。你看起来糟透了。

lines.en: : Do I really? I took a bath this morning and thought I looked mostly normal.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我今早洗了澡，觉得自己看起来基本正常啊。

lines.en: : You do. That’s exactly the problem.
lines.zh: : 是正常。问题恰恰在这儿。

lines.en: : Oh. So you’re just being mean again. Got it.
lines.zh: : 哦。那你就是又在犯刻薄了。明白了。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend5
: I didn’t want to shock you by caring so much as soon as I walked in. But, now that I’m here, you can cry if you want and I’ll only make fun of you a little bit.
lines.zh: : 我不想一进门就那么关心你，把你吓着。不过既然我都来了，你想哭就哭吧，我只会笑你一点点。

lines.en: : I don’t need to cry. Or want to. In fact, I’m not sure I even remember how. I just knew that being alone wasn’t going to be good for me and-
lines.zh: : 我不需要哭。也不想哭。事实上，我不确定我还记不记得怎么哭。我只是知道，一个人待着对我没好处，而且——

lines.en: : And you didn’t have the energy to go visit any of your many fan-clubs popping up throughout the city?
lines.zh: : 而且你没力气去城里那些如雨后春笋般冒出来的粉丝俱乐部转转？

lines.en: : I can’t tell if that’s in reference to the students or if Nodoka’s book is suddenly getting even more popular.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你指的是学生，还是 Nodoka 的书突然又火了一把。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend4
: I’ve been meaning to read that. Nagasawa is quite talented despite being utterly unbearable in practically every other way.
lines.zh: : 我一直想读那本书。长泽挺有才华的——尽管在其他几乎每一个方面都让人忍无可忍。

lines.en: : Don’t. Just hug me instead. I am ready.
lines.zh: : 别读。抱我就行。我准备好了。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend5
: Why stop at a hug when you can have something even better than that, Arakawa?
lines.zh: : 既然能得到比拥抱更好的东西，何必停在拥抱呢，荒川？

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend6
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : After all you’ve done for me in my times of need, I think it’s only fair that I go the extra mile for you today. Don’t you agree?
lines.zh: : 在我需要你的时候你为我做了那么多，我觉得今天我为你多走一步也很公平。你同意吧？

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhh...yes?
: But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend7
: But what?
lines.zh: : 不过什么？

lines.en: : Saying that while you’re tying your hair back makes it kind of look like you’re about to steer this “friendship” in a whole new direction that I was not expecting to happen so suddenly.
lines.zh: : 你一边把头发扎起来一边说这话，看起来就像要把这段「友情」拐进一个我完全没料到会这么突然发生的新方向。

lines.en: : I am. But as you know, I have very little experience doing this, so I can’t imagine I’ll do very well.
lines.zh: : 我就是要这么拐。不过你知道的，我这方面经验很浅，所以我想不会做得很好。

lines.en: : I suppose all that matters is that you enjoy it, though. So I’ll try my best even if I hate every second of it.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，重要的是你享受就行。所以就算我每一秒都厌恶，我也会尽力。

lines.en: : What...What about Osako? Is she, like...okay with this?
lines.zh: : 那……那 Osako 呢？她……能接受吗？

lines.en: : She doesn’t know I’m here. And I’d prefer you keep it a secret as well since things are already somewhat confusing between us.
lines.zh: : 她不知道我在这儿。而且我也希望你替我保密，毕竟我们之间现在已经够乱的了。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend8
: Why the fuck are you acting so weird? Just let it happen.
lines.zh: : 你他妈干嘛一副怪样子？让它发生就是了。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend9
: I mean...if you say so.
lines.zh: : 我是说……既然你这么说。

lines.en: : Arakawa? What are-
lines.zh: : 荒川？你在——

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend10
: Oh, for fucking- no! Put it away. I’m going to cook for you, you devious piece of shit. Not do that.
lines.zh: : 哦，操他妈的——不！收回去。我是要给你做饭的，你这阴险的狗东西。不是干那个。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend11
: Hah...
: I knew it was too good to be true.
lines.zh: : 我就知道好得不像真的。

lines.en: : You’re a filthy, pathetic degenerate. But at least your misery isn’t great enough to kill your libido. I’d say that’s a step forward.
lines.zh: : 你是个肮脏、可悲的堕落分子。不过至少你的痛苦还没严重到把你的性欲弄死。我得说这是个进步。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend12
: In my defense, you almost word-for-word recreated one of the best dreams I’ve ever had there. I can’t be blamed for giving into the fantasy when I’ve wanted it for so long.
lines.zh: : 替我自己说句公道话：你刚才几乎是逐字重现了我做过的最棒的一个梦。我想要这个想了那么久，挡不住幻想也不能怪我。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend13
: Is that really something you should be telling me while I’m holding multiple knives?
lines.zh: : 这话你真该在我手上有好几把刀的时候说吗？

lines.en: : No. But you weren’t holding them one CG ago, so I don’t think I can be blamed for that either.
lines.zh: : 不该。不过一个 CG 之前你还握着刀呢，所以这也不能怪我。

lines.en: : Also, when did you learn how to cook? Because I’m pretty sure you burned soup the last time I watched you try.
lines.zh: : 还有，你什么时候学会做饭的？我印象里上次看你煮汤，你把汤给煮糊了。

lines.en: : Only because your instructions were horrendous. And also because I can’t cook.
lines.zh: : 那只是因为你的指示烂透了。还因为我不会做饭。

lines.en: : I feel like one of those things implies that you probably shouldn’t cook today either then. Especially since you didn’t even bring any ingredients.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这两条里随便哪一条都说明你今天大概也不该下厨。尤其你连食材都没带。

lines.en: : I just planned on using whatever you had available. And if I couldn’t find anything, I figured I’d just shave off a piece of you instead and throw that over an open flame.
lines.zh: : 我本来就打算用你家里现成的。要是找不到，我就从你身上削一块下来，扔到明火上烤。

lines.en: : I may be disgustingly self-absorbed, but I don’t think it goes as far as wanting to eat myself.
lines.zh: : 我也许自我得令人作呕，但好像还没到想吃自己的程度。

lines.en: : Then fetch me three ingredients of your choosing. No more than that. Less is okay, though. I need to start small if I am ever going to improve.
lines.zh: : 那就给我拿三样你挑的食材。不超过三样。少一点也行。我要是想有长进，总得从小处做起。

lines.en: : Wakana, I appreciate the sentiment. But, as miserable as I am, I don’t think I want to die today. And for that reason, I am unable to try your cooking.
lines.zh: : Wakana，我很领你的情。不过虽然我现在很惨，我今天还不太想死。因为这个，我没法尝你的手艺。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend14
: It wasn’t so much the food that I was expecting you to enjoy, but the act of watching me fail at something since it is so exceedingly rare as I am already better than you at everything.
lines.zh: : 我本来指望你享受的也不是食物，而是「看我在某件事上失败」这个过程——毕竟我在所有事上都比你好，这种机会实在太稀有了。

lines.en: : Now that you mention it, that does sound exciting. I’m not really sure it’s going to cheer me up, though.
lines.zh: : 你这么一说，确实挺让人期待的。不过我不确定这能让我高兴起来。

lines.en: : Well, what do you suggest then? And don’t take that as an opportunity to unzip yourself again as I will not be found liable if I accidentally cut it off.
lines.zh: : 那你建议什么呢？别借机又去拉你的拉链——要是我一不小心把它切下来，我可不负责。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend15
: A movie and junk food — what an ordinary suggestion from someone I nearly had to castrate just a short while ago.
lines.zh: : 看电影加垃圾食品——这建议真平庸，尤其出自一个我刚差点要阉了他的人之口。

lines.en: : This is what I’d normally do with Ami and Niki when they didn’t hate my guts. I’m just trying to breathe some sort of normalcy back into this place.
lines.zh: : 这是 Ami 和 Niki 还没恨我入骨的时候，我常跟她们一起做的事。我只是想给这地方再吹进一点「正常」的空气。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend16
: Since when does Arakawa Jr. hate you? The two of you have always been sickeningly close from what I’ve seen.
lines.zh: : 荒川二世什么时候开始恨你了？我看到的你们俩，一直亲密得让人牙疼。

lines.en: : I like how you don’t question Niki suddenly hating me. Just Ami.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你居然不怀疑 Niki 突然恨我。只怀疑 Ami。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. That one makes a little more sense to me with how frequently you’re screwing our co-worker in public bathrooms.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对。考虑到你跟我们同事在公共卫生间上床的频率那么高，那一位恨你更合情理些。

lines.en: : If it’s okay, I’d rather not get into the specifics of it. All you really need to know is that Ami left and Niki broke up with me.
lines.zh: : 可以的话，我不想细说。你只需要知道：Ami 离开了，Niki 跟我分手了。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : Now, is this a situation where you’d like me to be on your side and trash-talk the two of them? Or would you rather, in true Arakawa fashion, have me belittle you instead and tell you it’s all your fault?
lines.zh: : 那么，你是想让我站你这边、把她们俩骂个狗血淋头？还是按荒川的老规矩，让我贬你一顿，告诉你全是你的错？

lines.en: : Is there a third option of just silently watching a movie together and maybe falling asleep on the couch?
lines.zh: : 有没有第三个选项——就安静地一起看个电影，也许在沙发上睡着？

lines.en: : There could be if I didn’t actually care. But knowing you went out of your way to ask me here makes me think just sitting in silence together isn’t going to be very helpful in the long run.
lines.zh: : 如果我不在乎你，那倒可以。可我知道你是特意叫我来的，这才让我觉得光是坐着不说话，长远来看不会有多大帮助。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend17
: I won’t think you’re “weak” if that’s what you’re concerned about. Which I imagine it is since I was concerned about the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我不会觉得你「软弱」——如果你担心的是这个的话。我猜你担心的就是这个，因为我当时也担心同样的事。

lines.en: : I already know I’m weak...I can talk about that no problem. It’s everything else that trips me up.
lines.zh: : 我早就知道自己软弱了……这个我谈起来没问题。绊住我的是别的一切。

lines.en: : It’s hard telling someone a story when there are a million details you need to omit and the ones left over make everything sound way too simple.
lines.zh: : 要讲一个故事，却有上百万个细节必须略去，剩下的那些又把一切讲得太过简单——这很难。

lines.en: : You’re a writer. I’m sure you can figure it out.
lines.zh: : 你是个作家。我相信你能想出办法。

lines.en: : See...that’s the thing, though. I can’t.
lines.zh: : 你看……问题就在这儿。我想不出。

lines.en: : And that’s just one more reason I chose poetry as my field of expertise since you don’t always need to tell a full story with that. You can normally just throw out a bunch of dots and have people connect them for you.
lines.zh: : 这也是我当初选诗歌当专业的又一个原因——诗不必总讲一个完整的故事。通常你只要撒一把点，让别人替你把点连起来就行。

lines.en: : You do know I’m quite adept at connecting those dots, don’t you? And still very interested in reading something of yours.
lines.zh: : 你知道我很擅长把那些点连起来吧？而且我依然很想读读你写的东西。

lines.en: : Just explain things to me in the simplest way for you and I can assure you I will only judge you a little bit.
lines.zh: : 用对你来说最简单的方式讲给我听就行，我保证只会稍微评判你一点点。

lines.en: : You’re always trying to get me to write, Wakana...no matter what the situation is.
lines.zh: : 你总是想让我写东西，Wakana……不管是什么场合。

lines.en: : Indeed. I am. And I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t annoyed by the fact you’ve never budged on that and have elected instead to just do nothing whenever you’re feeling down instead.
lines.zh: : 没错，我是。要说我不恼火那是谎话——你在这件事上从没松过口，反倒是每次心情不好就选择什么都不做。

lines.en: : You’ve got a perfectly good outlet waiting for you that you won’t even attempt to use. It’s like you’re some sort of mental masochist or something.
lines.zh: : 明明有一个再好不过的出口摆在那儿，你连试都不肯试。你就好像是某种精神受虐狂之类的。

lines.en: : Writers need to write. That’s how we’ve learned to feel. You not doing that even when I’m pushing you to is like making me watch you set yourself on fire.
lines.zh: : 作家需要写作。那是我们学会感受的方式。连我推着你你都不写，那感觉就像逼我看你把自己点着。

lines.en: : And I really hate that, Arakawa. I don’t want you to suffer more than you already have.
lines.zh: : 而我真的很讨厌这样，荒川。我不想看你比现在更受苦。

lines.en: : Writing is suffering though, Wakana. How am I supposed to do that when all it does is remind me of what I’ve lost?
lines.zh: : 可写作本身就是受苦啊，Wakana。它只会让我想起我失去了什么，我怎么做得到？

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend18
: Are you gonna say something? Or is that the end of this conversation?
lines.zh: : 你打算说点什么吗？还是这场对话就到这儿了？

lines.en: : Frankly, Arakawa — I’m not sure what I’m allowed to say at this point when you’ve already threatened our friendship over this subject before.
lines.zh: : 说实话，荒川——你以前就为这个话题威胁过我们的友情，我现在不确定自己还能说什么。

lines.en: : Like I said, I’m good at connecting the dots. But when I’m told to stop doing that and you try to push me to, I can’t help but feel a little trapped.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，我很擅长把点连起来。可当我被叫停，一会儿你又推着我去连，我忍不住觉得自己被困住了。

lines.en: : Then, if I lift the embargo on talking about what I’m sure you’ve already figured out...will that get you to stop trying to make me write?
lines.zh: : 那么，如果我解除禁令，允许你谈论那个你肯定已经想明白的东西……你就能不再逼我写作了吗？

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend19

lines.zh: : 不会……

lines.en: : But it’ll make me happy knowing you trust me enough to talk to me about it.
lines.zh: : 但知道你足够信任我、愿意跟我谈这件事，我会很高兴。

lines.en: : It’s never been about trust. It’s about not wanting to feel like there’s a bomb inside of me just waiting to go off.
lines.zh: : 从来都不是信任的问题。是我不想觉得自己的身体里有一颗等着引爆的炸弹。

lines.en: : And it’s really the way you felt about her that’s causing that? Not...what happened?
lines.zh: : 那真的只是你对她的感情造成的？不是……发生过的事？

lines.en: : You wouldn’t understand.
lines.zh: : 你不会懂的。

lines.en: : Arakawa, barring your niece or daughter or whatever you want to call her, I’ve read the Girl Who Cannot Breathe more than probably anyone you know. Do you know why?
lines.zh: : 荒川，除了你的侄女也好女儿也好（随便你怎么称呼她），我读《无法呼吸的女孩》的次数，大概比你认识的任何人都要多。你知道为什么吗？

lines.en: : Because you’re nosy and obsessed with weird poets?
lines.zh: : 因为你爱打听，又对古怪诗人着迷？

lines.en: : Because it’s the only way I can learn more about you when you won’t tell me anything.
lines.zh: : 因为在你什么都不肯说的时候，这是我了解你的唯一途径。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend20
: And I guess maybe I’m a little nosy too...but only because I care.
lines.zh: : 而且我想，我大概也有点爱打听……但只是因为我在乎。

lines.en: : And I imagine you’d do the same thing if you found out I had a secret romance with an older man as a child.
lines.zh: : 而且我想，要是你发现我小时候跟一个年长的男人有过一段秘密恋情，你也会做同样的事。

lines.en: : You concede that it was romance, then?
lines.zh: : 那你承认那是一段恋情了？

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend21
: From a moral standpoint, no...
lines.zh: : 从道德上说，不是……

lines.en: : But I’m willing to acknowledge that no third party can ever truly understand the feelings two other people have for each other.
lines.zh: : 但我愿意承认：任何第三者都永远无法真正理解另外两个人之间的感情。

lines.en: : And between what I’ve read from her work and how greatly her existence impacted you...it’d be foolish to not acknowledge the existence of some form of love there.
lines.zh: : 而介于我从她的作品里读到的、以及她的存在对你的巨大影响……要是不承认那里存在某种形式的爱，那就太蠢了。

lines.en: : It makes me a little sick to my stomach, though...the Boy, or...you, since I guess we’re finally addressing this is...
lines.zh: : 不过这让我有点反胃……那个男孩，或者……你，既然我们终于要谈这个了，就是……

lines.en: : Well...he always appears so...helpless...and innocent in her poetry. Like he didn’t fully understand what was going on. Which, given how old you must have been...
lines.zh: : 嗯……在她的诗里，他总是显得那么……无助……又无辜。好像他并不完全明白发生了什么。想想你当时才多大……

lines.en: : It was true at first.
lines.zh: : 一开始是这样的。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend22
: I idolized her...Thought she must have been some sort of angel. So when she wanted to spend more time with me, I happily obliged.
lines.zh: : 我把她当偶像……觉得她一定是某种天使。所以当她想多陪我时，我欣然接受。

lines.en: : I’d have accepted anyone back then...and I’m just lucky it was someone who really seemed to care about me.
lines.zh: : 那时候我谁都会接受……而我只是运气好，碰上的恰好是一个真的关心我的人。

lines.en: : So when it got sexual, I never really...tried to stop her. Not seriously, at least. Especially knowing that doing so would likely form a rift in the only good relationship I ever had.
lines.zh: : 所以到了有性的时候，我从来没有真的……试着阻止她。至少没有认真试过。尤其是我知道，这么做很可能会在我唯一一段美好关系里撕出一道裂痕。

lines.en: : I just didn’t want to lose her. And the more time we spent together, the more I realized just how important she was to me. Or...is.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想失去她。而且我们在一起的时间越久，我就越明白她对我有多重要。或者说……现在有多重要。

lines.en: : I can still see her sometimes. Smell her. And...you know, it’ll sound weird, but I can almost feel her hanging over my shoulder every time I pick up a pen. Correcting me...making suggestions.
lines.zh: : 有时候我还能看见她。闻到她的味道。而且……你知道，这话听着奇怪，但每次我拿起笔，我几乎能感觉到她悬在我肩后。纠正我……给我提建议。

lines.en: : I just...I want to avoid that because it hurts too much. And I thought that might change when I stopped holding back the memories, but...no luck.
lines.zh: : 我只是……我想避开这个，因为太疼了。我以为等我不再压着那些记忆，情况会变，但……没这运气。

lines.en: : So now here I am, miserable again with no way to express it, and the ones I’ve held closest suddenly giving up on me.
lines.zh: : 所以现在我又回到了这里：再次痛苦，却无从表达，而我最亲近的那些人突然都放弃了我。

lines.en: : I haven’t given up on you, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 我没有放弃你，荒川。

lines.en: : I could make you if I wanted to...and it’d be really easy.
lines.zh: : 我只要想，就能让你放弃我……而且非常容易。

lines.en: : Try me.
lines.zh: : 试试看。

lines.en: : No...That’s how easy I know it would be.
lines.zh: : 不……我就是知道它会有多容易。

lines.en: : What would make you feel better then? Right now. Apart from a blowjob.
lines.zh: : 那现在怎样能让你好受点？除了口交。

lines.en: : I don’t know...handjob, maybe?
lines.zh: : 我不知道……打飞机，也许？

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend23
: Arakawa, be serious. I came here to try and help you and I feel like all I’ve done is make things worse.
lines.zh: : 荒川，认真点。我是来帮你的，可我觉得我只是让事情更糟了。

lines.en: : You haven’t made anything worse. I’ve been trying to be more open about stuff and...I know how badly you wanted to talk about this, so I kind of expected it to happen soon enough.
lines.zh: : 你没有让任何事更糟。我一直在试着对这些事更开放一点，而且……我知道你有多想谈这个，所以我多少预料到它迟早会发生。

lines.en: : But right now, I...
lines.zh: : 但现在，我……

lines.en: : ...You, what?
: Don’t make fun of me, okay?
lines.zh: : 别笑我，好吗？

lines.en: : I’ll do my best.
lines.zh: : 我尽量。

lines.en: : I just want Ami to come home.
lines.zh: : 我只想让 Ami 回家。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend24
: I’ve really fucked her up, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 我真的把她搞坏了，Wakana。

lines.en: : I’m sure I don’t need to tell you how hard it would be growing up with me as a father.
lines.zh: : 我想不用我告诉你，有我这么个父亲长大有多难。

lines.en: : Probably not as bad as you think if you feel that strongly about her. That was the most human thing I’ve ever heard you say.
lines.zh: : 既然你对她有这么深的感情，大概没你想的那么糟。这是我听你说过最像人的一句话。

lines.en: : You’ve seen her in school, right? Does she seem normal?
lines.zh: : 你在学校见过她吧？她看起来正常吗？

lines.en: : I’ve seen her in the halls, but I haven’t talked to her.
lines.zh: : 我在走廊上见过她，但没跟她说过话。

lines.en: : I could, though...I should be able to free up some time in my schedule.
lines.zh: : 不过我可以……我应该能从日程里挤出点时间。

lines.en: : And, in the event that I do, is there anything you’d like me say? Any sort of message you’d like to convey?
lines.zh: : 要是我真去见她，你有什么想让我说的吗？有什么想传达的话？

lines.en: : Just tell her I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 就告诉她我很抱歉。

lines.en: : Are you sorry? For whatever it is that happened and forced the two of you apart?
lines.zh: : 你抱歉吗？为了那个发生、并把你们俩拆开的事？

lines.en: : Not really. But I’m not above lying if it makes my life a little easier.
lines.zh: : 不太。不过只要能让日子好过点，我也不介意撒个谎。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend25
: Oh? Do you ever lie to me?
lines.zh: : 哦？你对我撒过谎吗？

lines.en: : Probably. I can’t really think of any examples off the top of my head though.
lines.zh: : 大概有吧。不过我一时想不出具体的例子。

lines.en: : Guess I’ll have to look out then.
lines.zh: : 那我以后得留个心眼了。

lines.en: : How about you, Wakana? Do you ever lie to me?
lines.zh: : 你呢，Wakana？你对我撒过谎吗？

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend26
: Mhm. All the time.
lines.zh: : 嗯。一直在撒。

lines.en: scene wakanathefriend27
: Like you said...makes life easier.
lines.zh: : 就像你说的……让日子好过些。

lines.en: : Guess I’ll have to look out too, then.
lines.zh: : 那我也得留个心眼了。

lines.en: : Don’t look too hard. You might not like what you see.
lines.zh: : 别看得太用力。你也许不会喜欢你看到的东西。

lines.en: : I don’t know...I feel like I could look at you all day and like every second of it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我觉得我可以看你一整天，而且每一秒都喜欢。

lines.en: : Suspicious thing to say right after telling me you habitually lie to me all the time.
lines.zh: : 在你刚告诉我你习惯性地一直对我撒谎之后说这种话，着实可疑。

lines.en: : Did I say “habitually?” Because I’d like you to think my lies are much more rare than that.
lines.zh: : 我说「习惯性地」了吗？我希望你认为我的谎比那要稀少得多。

lines.en: : And I’d like you to stop staring at me...
lines.zh: : 还有，我希望你别再盯着我看……

lines.en: : It’s making me sick.
lines.zh: : 这让我反胃。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine. Guess I’ll finally put a movie on now that my sob story is over.
lines.zh: : 好吧。既然我的哭诉讲完了，我想我终于可以放部电影了。

lines.en: : And with a lot less crying than mine. Color me impressed, Arakawa. I brought a handkerchief for you and everything. I was really hoping for tears.
lines.zh: : 而且哭得比我那次少多了。算我惊喜到了，荒川。我连手帕都给你带来了。我可是一心盼着看你掉眼泪的。

lines.en: : Maybe next time. Any Netflix suggestions?
lines.zh: : 也许下次吧。有什么 Netflix 推荐吗？

lines.en: : Mmm...don’t hate me. Dead Poets Society.
lines.zh: : 嗯……别恨我。《死亡诗社》。

lines.en: : Get out of my house.
lines.zh: : 滚出我家。

lines.zh: Wakana 的好感度提升了 10！
